fees.description: May be charged when manually reconnecting or reading your meter when you move into a property or change retailer. Incl GST. Fees may vary.
May be charged when manually disconnecting or reading your meter when you move out of a property or change retailer. Incl GST. Fees may vary.
Fee may be charged when manually disconnecting your meter in other circumstances, such as non-payment. Includes GST. Fees may vary.
May be charged when manually reconnecting in other circumstances, such as after disconnection for non-payment. Includes GST. Fees may vary
A late payment fee may be charged when full payment has not been received by the bill due date. This amount is not subject to GST
The amount is GST inclusive and applies to card payments made at Australia Post outlets.

The amount is GST inclusive and applies to payments made by Visa credit cards.

electricityContract.terms: This offer applies to customers with a smart meter and an applicable network tariff. For solar feed-in tariff eligibility, or for further information about the terms and conditions applicable to this energy offer, please contact AGL on 131 245 or visit agl.com.au. AGL's standard retail contract rates are updated periodically on agl.com.au/src. For solar customers, discounts are applied before solar credits are applied.
electricityContract.variation: We'll vary energy rates no more than once every 6 months. If we do, we'll publish the variation in a newspaper and on our website at least 10 business days before it takes effect. For any increases we'll notify you at least 5 business days prior (or 10 business days for Queensland electricity), or by your next bill where there is a reduction (or at least 5 business days prior for Queensland electricity). Other charges may be varied with notice.

incentives.description: Free electricity usage applies from 11am to 2pm every day up to the reasonable use cap of 24kWh/day. Above 24 kWh/day, <7.36 cents/kWh> will be charged. Daily supply charges still apply. This ratecan change with notice to you.

greenPowerCharges.description: For 1.1c /kWh inc. GST we ensure energy equal to 100% of your usage will be fed into the grid from Accredited GreenPower generators.
